## Purpose and Entrypoints
Traefik is a Go-based, single-binary edge proxy and load balancer. It discovers workload topology from infrastructure APIs or configuration sources, continuously derives routing configuration, and serves HTTP, TCP, and UDP traffic without restart-based reconfiguration. The executable is bootstrapped in `cmd/traefik/traefik.go`; static configuration is assembled through `cmd/configuration.go` and CLI/file/environment loaders in `pkg/cli/`.

## Configuration Model and Runtime State
Static configuration defines process-level concerns such as entry points, enabled providers, API/dashboard, TLS resolvers, plugins, and observability. Dynamic configuration models routers, services, middleware, and TLS resources separately for HTTP, TCP, and UDP. Runtime representations materialize those declarative models into active handlers.
Paths: `pkg/config/static/static_config.go`, `pkg/config/dynamic/config.go`, `pkg/config/runtime/runtime.go`.

## Discovery Providers and Configuration Aggregation
Providers translate external state into dynamic configuration and publish updates. Sources include Docker/Swarm, Kubernetes variants (Ingress, CRD, Gateway API, Knative, ingress-nginx), ECS, Nomad, Consul Catalog, file/HTTP, and KV backends (Consul, etcd, Redis, ZooKeeper). The aggregator is the boundary that receives provider updates and merges them into the effective configuration consumed by the server.
Paths: `pkg/provider/aggregator/aggregator.go`, `pkg/provider/docker/pdocker.go`, `pkg/provider/kubernetes/gateway/kubernetes.go`.

## Server Reconciliation and Listener Lifecycle
The server owns entry-point listeners, signal/shutdown handling, configuration watching, and atomic application of new router/service graphs. It separates configuration ingestion from traffic serving: updates enter through the configuration watcher and are reconciled into protocol-specific routers while existing listeners continue serving.
Paths: `pkg/server/server.go`, `pkg/server/configurationwatcher.go`, `pkg/server/routerfactory.go`.

## Request and Connection Routing
Incoming connections are accepted on configured TCP or UDP entry points. TCP logic classifies TLS/TCP/HTTP traffic and dispatches to HTTP or TCP routers; UDP uses its own router path. HTTP and TCP muxers evaluate rule matchers and priorities, then select configured middleware and service chains.
Paths: `pkg/server/server_entrypoint_tcp.go`, `pkg/muxer/http/mux.go`, `pkg/server/router/tcp/manager.go`.

## Middleware, Services, and Upstream Proxying
For matched routes, middleware factories build ordered request/connection transformations: authentication, headers, IP allowlists, rate limits, retry, compression, redirects, error handling, and observability. Service managers create load-balanced upstream handlers, including weighted, sticky, failover, mirroring, least-time, and power-of-two-choices strategies. HTTP forwarding supports a standard implementation and an optional fast proxy path.
Paths: `pkg/server/middleware/middlewares.go`, `pkg/server/service/service.go`, `pkg/proxy/smart_builder.go`.

## TLS, Certificates, and Control Plane APIs
TLS management supplies certificate stores, TLS options, SNI selection, OCSP handling, and certificate resolvers. ACME support obtains and stores certificates through HTTP/TLS challenges; Tailscale is also represented as a certificate-provider integration. The internal API exposes active routers, services, middleware, certificates, entry points, and support/debug data; the embedded dashboard consumes this API.
Paths: `pkg/tls/tlsmanager.go`, `pkg/provider/acme/provider.go`, `pkg/api/handler.go`.

## Runtimes, Delivery, and Observability
The main runtime is Go; deployment is supported as a container via `Dockerfile` and commonly targets Docker, Kubernetes, and other orchestrators. Logs, access logs, metrics, and tracing are integrated as traffic-path concerns, with Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, Datadog, StatsD, and InfluxDB implementations. The dashboard is a TypeScript/React application built with Vite and embedded into the Go binary.
Paths: `pkg/observability/observability.go`, `webui/src/index.tsx`, `webui/embed.go`.
